kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتقابل (form VI)
# نَتَقَابَلُ (nataqābalu) /na.ta.qaː.ba.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# نَتَقَابَلَ (nataqābala) /na.ta.qaː.ba.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# نَتَقَابَلْ (nataqābal) /na.ta.qaː.bal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
